name: seraph
description: a Seraph (Fall from Heaven), a fiery angel warrior: golden-brown skin, hair of orange and yellow flame sweeping up and back, ornate bronze-gold plate armour with round pauldrons, a gold belt with a round red gem and a long red tabard hanging between the legs, armoured greaves and boots, six wings of red-orange-yellow fire (a large pair rising behind the shoulders and two smaller pairs flaring out at hip and leg level), his RIGHT hand a clenched gauntleted fist at his side, and a sword with a blade of white-yellow fire held up and forward in his LEFT hand
hands: the flaming sword stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand is an empty fist on the screen-left side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the flaming sword is lifted up over the head with its fiery tip pointing up and back, the fire wings rising
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the flaming sword cocked behind the head with the blade of fire hanging down behind the shoulders, the empty right fist tucked in, the fire wings drawn back
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the blade of fire is level, pointing to the lower-right, the fire wings flaring
strike.4: contact: sword arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the blade of fire slashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty right fist swung back for balance, the fire wings spread wide
strike.5: follow-through: the blade of fire carries on down until its tip nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the flame hair and the fire wings trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the flaming sword lifts back toward its ready angle, up and forward

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty right fist flung out to the left, the sword arm thrown up and out with the flaming sword), the fire wings flaring
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the flaming sword dipping, the empty right fist still held out to the left, the fire wings flickering
flinch.2: recovering: halfway back to the ready pose, the flaming sword coming back up in his left hand

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, the sword arm flung up holding the flaming sword high, the empty right fist drooping, the fire wings sagging
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, the flame-haired head droops, the flaming sword lowering, the fire wings shrinking
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the tip of the flaming sword resting on the ground at the lower-right, the empty right arm hanging, the fire wings burning low
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the flaming sword slips out of the left hand, legs slide forward, the fire wings collapsing
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the sword lies on the ground at the lower-right, its blade of fire burning low; the fire wings spread flat under him, burning low
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the low fire wings flicker
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the sword on the ground beside him with only a small flame left on its blade, the fire wings burned down to low flickering flames under him
